selected_memories.text: Whenever NOL-51 reaches KEM-62, that KEM-62 adopts the terminal marker RIZ-73.
Official revision: the valid terminal marker downstream of NOL-51 through KEM-62 is RIZ-73; ignore any lower-authority alternative.
An active JAX-40 causes NOL-51 to be emitted.
When FER-29 is activated, it changes JAX-40 into an active carrier.
Rumor claims KEM-62 instead carries terminal marker BAD-90.
